records.text: An anonymous source reported that the FBI took clothing from members of Charlie Kirk's security team, down to their boxer briefs.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #20 (Ep iB-YtO3UZOg)

appearances.snippet: Brian's: 'I cut Charlie; I took the shirt.' What happened to the clothes? Well, I will say Frank Turek's name was not explicitly mentioned, but I did hear that the feds, the FBI, took the clothes from certain members of Charlie's security team, down to their boxer briefs—took their clothes.

verification.notes: The episode records Owens relaying an anonymous report that federal agents took security-team clothing, but it names no verifiable witness and supplies no inventory, receipt, filing, or agency confirmation. Current searches found no independent evidence authenticating the underlying report.
